SELECT AVG(1999 - CAST(strftime('%Y', p.Birthday) AS INTEGER)) AS average_age_years
FROM main.Patient AS p
WHERE p.ID IN (
    SELECT l.ID
    FROM main.Laboratory AS l
    WHERE l."U-PRO" IN ('3', '4', '300', '>=300', '1000', '>=1000')
)
LIMIT 1
